rate_key.description: Stable unique billing-rate key, such as ce_trainer_registration, ce_student_reactivation, or ce_cohort_monthly_overage.

description.description: Internal explanation of what triggers this rate.

billing_subject_type.description: Type of item or person this rate applies to.

feature_key.description: Optional related PlatformFeature key, such as ce_cohorts.

amount_cents.description: Current unit price in cents. For example, 4900 represents $49.

ends_at.description: When this rate stops being usable, if replaced.

stripe_price_id.description: Stripe Price ID once Stripe collection is connected.

is_active.description: Controls whether new billing events may use this rate.

notes.description: Internal billing notes, including grandfathered terms or replacement-rate details.
